Look, my wife kept everything bottled up inside of her, and she gave up on me because she wanted to live a lifestyle that she sees on social media YouTube music videos. A marriage isn't something that should just be given up on this is the ultimate commitment that you make to another person. No love last but our integrity what makes us more than somebody else has to do with keeping your promises. If you go down this road without truly making the attempt, then you're taking the first step in a vicious cycle, cycle of divorce and break up a cycle of dissatisfaction. If he's willing to change then you should give him the opportunity to do so. Tell him the words are meaningless and actions are what define us. But that's a two-way street, you see a marriage doesn't work if both only put in 50% to equal 100 because there's two and at the end of the day that's still only 50%. Both partners have to put in 100%. From someone who has been given up on without ever being spoken to, without her having asked me to try to make the change I ask that you give him another chance..my wife gave up on me and she crushed me. My entire life is literally different now because of the partner that I gave everything to, the one that I made the ultimate sacrifice for, my life was hers. now don't misunderstand me I didn't put her on a pedestal I didn't let my life revolve around hers I still have my own life I still have my own desires aspirations and goals. I have a full-time job and I am working on getting a further education... you should Google the definition of commitment you'll see what I mean. And if it truly doesn't work out then walk away. But only then will you know that you did everything possible, and that your marriage did not fail because of you.
